careers.title: Software Engineer
careers.description: Build and maintain software systems. One of Pakistan's fastest-growing fields with strong remote and freelance opportunities.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Extract insights from data to drive business decisions. Growing rapidly in Pakistan's fintech and e-commerce sectors.

careers.title: AI / ML Engineer
careers.description: Design and deploy AI models. Pakistan's AI ecosystem is expanding with companies like Arbisoft, 10Pearls, and remote global roles.

careers.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
careers.description: Drive online growth through marketing campaigns. Pakistan's booming e-commerce and freelance market offers abundant opportunities.

careers.title: UX / UI Designer
careers.description: Design intuitive digital experiences. Increasingly valued by Pakistani tech companies and international remote teams.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protect organisations from cyber threats. Critical role as Pakistan's digital infrastructure grows.

careers.title: Cloud / DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Manage cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. High demand from both local companies and global remote positions.

careers.title: Product Manager
careers.description: Lead product vision and execution. Pakistani startups and scale-ups increasingly need skilled PMs.

careers.title: Mobile App Developer
careers.description: Build mobile applications. Pakistan has a strong mobile-first user base, creating steady demand.

careers.title: Business Analyst
careers.description: Bridge business needs with technical solutions. Important role in Pakistan's growing IT services sector.

careers.title: Content Creator / Strategist
careers.description: Create and strategise digital content. Pakistan's creator economy and brand marketing spend are growing rapidly.

careers.title: Blockchain Developer
careers.description: Build decentralised applications. Pakistan ranks among top countries in crypto adoption and blockchain freelancing.

careers.title: Healthcare IT Specialist
careers.description: Digitise healthcare systems. Pakistan's health-tech sector is expanding with companies like Marham, Oladoc, and Sehat Kahani.

careers.title: FinTech Analyst
careers.description: Drive innovation in financial services. Pakistan's fintech ecosystem (Easypaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay, NayaPay) is booming.

careers.title: Project Manager
careers.description: Lead projects to successful delivery. Essential across IT services, construction, and development sectors in Pakistan.

careers.title: Freelance Tech Consultant
careers.description: Work independently with global clients. Pakistan is the 4th largest freelancing market globally.

careers.title: EdTech Specialist
careers.description: Transform education through technology. Pakistan's EdTech sector (Sabaq, Maqsad, Knowledge Platform) is expanding rapidly.

careers.title: Full Stack Developer
careers.description: Handle both frontend and backend development. One of the most versatile and in-demand roles in Pakistan's tech industry.
